sql: WITH actor_works AS (SELECT p.name_id, AVG(t.average_rating) AS actor_avg_rating FROM principals p JOIN titles t ON p.title_id = t.id WHERE p.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') AND t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name_id), director_works AS (SELECT p.name_id, AVG(t.average_rating) AS director_avg_rating FROM principals p JOIN titles t ON p.title_id = t.id WHERE p.category_id = 'director' AND t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name_id) SELECT n.primary_name, ROUND(a.actor_avg_rating, 2) AS actor_avg_rating, ROUND(d.director_avg_rating, 2) AS director_avg_rating FROM actor_works a JOIN director_works d ON a.name_id = d.name_id JOIN names n ON a.name_id = n.id
